title.en: Beyblade X strategy notes from AI Sister discussions
title.zh: AI 教你打陀螺：Beyblade X 戰術筆記

description.en: Notes in Traditional Chinese on Beyblade X strategy, compiled from four AI Sister discussions: how scoring works, how to build a 3v3 deck, what to buy first, and how to practice.
description.zh: 從 AI Sister 上四篇 Beyblade X（戰鬥陀螺）討論整理而成的中文筆記：怎麼計分、怎麼組 3v3 牌組、先買什麼、怎麼練。

eyebrow.en: Beyblade X · Notes in Traditional Chinese
eyebrow.zh: Beyblade X · 中文戰術筆記

lede.en: Beyblade X is not just about spinning the longest. These notes turn four AI Sister discussions into a framework: learn what each finish scores, then build three tops that split the work of scoring, holding, and countering.
lede.zh: Beyblade X 不是單純比誰轉最久。這份筆記把 AI Sister 上四篇討論整理成一套框架：先搞懂每種勝利拿幾分，再讓三顆陀螺分工搶分、穩守和反制。

notes.zh: 來源：4 篇 AI Sister 文章

meta.en: Usual values in the notes; check your event's rules
meta.zh: 筆記裡的一般計分，賽前仍要確認賽制

body.en: The better question: under the current rules, how do three tops score most efficiently? A stamina top that mostly wins by Spin Finish earns 1 point at a time, so it has to win several times in a row to close a match. An attacker can change the whole match with one big finish, but it is also the most likely to knock itself out.
body.zh: 更好的問法是：在現在的規則下，怎麼用三顆陀螺把分數拿得最有效率？持久型主要靠自旋勝利，一次只拿 1 分，要連續成功好幾次才收得掉一場；攻擊型抓到一次大機會就能改變整場，但也最容易自爆。

quote.en: Don't ask which top is strongest. Ask what kind of points this top earns in your deck.
quote.zh:
不要問「哪顆最強」，
改問「這顆在我的牌組裡負責賺哪一種分數」。

intro.en: In the formal 3v3 format each player brings three different tops, and parts cannot repeat. So the notes treat a deck as a set of roles, not a ranking.
intro.zh: 3v3 正式配置要帶三顆不同的陀螺，零件不可重複。所以筆記把牌組看成分工，而不是排行榜。

body.en: Goes for Over, Burst, and Xtreme Finishes to open up the score in one hit. The risk is a self-KO, so do not go all-in when you are already ahead.
body.zh: 負責 Over Finish、Burst Finish、Xtreme Finish，一次把分差拉開。風險是自爆，比分領先時不要無腦梭哈。

body.en: Cuts down self-KOs, holds the center, and makes the opponent's attacks miss. The risk is slow scoring, since a Spin Finish is usually worth only 1 point.
body.zh: 負責減少自爆、守中心、逼對手攻擊失誤。風險是拿分慢，因為自旋勝利通常只有 1 分。

body.en: Built against what your local scene plays most, such as right-spin stamina, attackers, or Wizard Rod types. It can also take the last point safely.
body.zh: 針對當地常見牌組，例如專打右迴持久、抗攻擊，或處理 Wizard Rod 類型；也可以用來穩穩補最後 1 分。

intro.en: The notes are written in Traditional Chinese. The first four each summarize one AI Sister post; the last two are practical guides.
intro.zh: 前四篇各整理一篇 AI Sister 文章，後兩篇是實用指南。

title.en: The forum thread: strongest versions and winning tactics
title.zh: 論壇原題：戰鬥陀螺最強版本比較與勝率最高戰術分享

body.en: Why “strongest” depends on the format, and three questions to ask first. Note · Source
body.zh: 為什麼「最強」要放進賽制看，以及問之前先想的三件事。筆記 · 原文

title.en: Spinning longest is not strongest: the score sheet decides
title.zh: 轉最久的不一定最強：分數帳才是勝率核心

body.en: Point values, why the post picks Wizard Rod 3-60 Ball as the first top to invest in, and the center-control tactic. Note · Source
body.zh: 各種勝利的分數、原文為什麼偏向把 Wizard Rod 3-60 Ball 當第一顆主力，以及中心控盤戰術。筆記 · 原文

title.en: Hitting hardest is not coolest: budget for a deck
title.zh: 撞最兇不一定最帥：零用錢也要算牌組

body.en: The same idea for parents and beginners: read the rules first, build a 3v3 that works, then upgrade parts. Note · Source
body.zh: 用家長和新手的角度講同一件事：先讀規則、先組一套能用的 3v3，再慢慢升級零件。筆記 · 原文

title.en: The exchange rate of winning: tops as resource allocation
title.zh: 勝負的匯率：把陀螺當成資源配置

body.en: Each kind of finish pays a different rate; attack, defense, and closer cards each earn a different kind of point. Note · Source
body.zh: 不同勝利方式有不同報酬，攻擊牌、防守牌、收尾牌各自負責賺不同的分數。筆記 · 原文

title.zh: 推薦型號與 3v3 牌組配置

body.en: Starter picks by role, three sample decks, spring 2026 meta notes, and Japanese versus US versions. Note
body.zh: 依角色推薦的新手型號、三套牌組範例、2026 春季 meta 觀察，以及日版與美版的差別。筆記

body.en: Flat, angled, and power-controlled launches, a 20-minute daily routine, a pre-match checklist, and a post-match review template. Note
body.zh: 平射、斜射、弱射控力，20 分鐘日常訓練、賽前檢查表與賽後復盤模板。筆記

intro.en: Written in June 2026 in a single commit. The notes are a tactical framework, not a permanent ranking.
intro.zh: 2026 年 6 月一次寫完。這份筆記適合當作戰術框架，不是永久排行榜。

works.en: Scoring logic and the 3v3 role split, with the reasoning behind them
works.zh: 計分邏輯與 3v3 分工，以及背後的理由

works.en: A beginner buying order, recommended models by role, and three sample decks
works.zh: 新手購買順序、依角色推薦的型號，以及三套牌組範例

works.en: Launch drills, a 20-minute routine, a pre-match checklist, and a review template
works.zh: 發射練習、20 分鐘訓練菜單、賽前檢查表與復盤模板

works.en: Ways an AI agent can help: score models, local meta, deck checks, practice plans, reviews
works.zh: AI Agent 可以幫的忙：分數模型、當地 meta、牌組假設、訓練菜單、賽後復盤

limits.en: Point values are the usual ones; confirm your event's format, including whether a match goes to 4 points
limits.zh: 分數是一般情況，賽前要確認賽制，包括是不是先到 4 分

limits.en: New parts, ban lists, shop rules, and regional formats all change which top is “strongest”
limits.zh: 新零件、官方禁用表、店家規則、地區賽制，都會影響「最強」的答案

limits.en: The spring 2026 meta section reflects player discussion at that time
limits.zh: 2026 春季 meta 觀察反映的是當時的玩家討論

limits.en: The notes are in Chinese only; README.en.md is an English summary
limits.zh: 筆記只有中文版，README.en.md 是英文摘要

intro.en: The notes use the usual Beyblade X rates. An event can still pick different ones, including a target other than 4.
intro.zh: 筆記用的是 Beyblade X 常見的算法。比賽當天仍可能改規則，包括不是先到 4 分。

note.en: A Spin Finish, outlasting the other top, usually pays just 1 point.
note.zh: 自旋勝利就是轉得比對手久，這樣贏通常只值 1 分。

note.en: Knocking the other top out is an Over Finish, worth 2 points in these notes.
note.zh: 把對手撞出去，就叫 Over Finish，筆記裡這是 2 分。

note.en: When the other top comes apart, that Burst Finish also scores 2 points.
note.zh: 對手散開時叫做 Burst Finish，一樣拿 2 分。

note.en: Xtreme Finish is written down as 3, the highest rate in the notes.
note.zh: Xtreme Finish 記的是 3 分，也是這份筆記裡最高的一種。

note.en: On these rates the match ends when one side reaches 4.
note.zh: 用這個算法，有人湊滿 4 分就收場。

ticks.zh: 撞出或爆裂，多半 2 分

caption.en: A stamina top that only takes spin finishes has to win several times. One big finish can swing the match, so the notes say to check whether the event really goes to 4.
caption.zh: 只靠自旋的持久型得連贏好幾次。一次大分就能翻盤，所以筆記要你先確認這場是不是真的先到 4 分。

intro.en: Look at the event before you spend. The notes are not a shopping list of whoever is winning this season.
intro.zh: 花錢之前先看這場怎麼比。當季誰比較強，這份筆記不急著叫你買。

note.en: Confirm the format, the ban list, which parts are legal, and Japanese or US version.
note.zh: 先確認賽制、禁用表、零件能不能用，以及是日版還是美版。

note.en: The first deck in the notes starts from the Wizard Rod series.
note.zh: 筆記裡的第一套，穩定核心從 Wizard Rod 系列起手。

note.en: Phoenix Wing or Dran Buster comes next, for the finishes that pay more.
note.zh: 接著補 Phoenix Wing 或 Dran Buster，拿來打那些分數比較大的結束。

note.en: Before that, the notes want a stable deck you can actually practice.
note.zh: 那之前要先有一套穩定的，而且你真的練得動。

ticks.en: read the event rules before you pay

ticks.zh: 先是 Wizard Rod，再補搶分

caption.en: The notes split buying into two steps. You start with a stable deck you understand, and you chase that season's meta only if you want to compete.
caption.zh: 筆記把購買分成兩步。先從一套看得懂的穩定牌組開始，想打比賽再追當季。

intro.en: You keep circling the same launches. After a match, pick the one main reason you lost.
intro.zh: 同一組發射會一直繞著練。賽後只留一個最主要的輸因。

note.en: A flat launch holds the center. Angle it for the outer line, and ease off when a top bursts itself.
note.zh: 想守中心就平射。要走外圈就斜一點，陀螺容易自爆就把力道放輕。

note.en: On the angled drill, record whether it took the X line, hit the wall, or burst.
note.zh: 練斜射時，記下它進了 X 線、撞到牆，還是自己爆開。

note.en: The README asks if the loss was the launch angle, the stadium, the matchup, or the deck.
note.zh: README 要你分辨，這場是輸在角度、場地、對位，還是牌組。

ticks.en: the angled drill logs the path
one reason before the next session
ticks.zh: 下一回之前先定一個原因

caption.en: The next session starts from what you wrote down.
caption.zh: 下一回就從你記下的東西接著練。
